nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Circular economy initiatives|Circular approaches in manufacturing_qna_000
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What measures are needed to move industries towards the new Sustainable-Circular Production (SCP) model besides recycling?
nodes.answer: Besides recycling, industries need to implement preventive measures such as minimizing waste and resource consumption, rethinking manufacturing processes, eliminating hazardous substances, optimizing resource use and reuse, and improving scrap management.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Circular economy initiatives|Circular approaches in manufacturing_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the main issue highlighted in the chemical management subsection for all three factories?
nodes.answer: The main issue highlighted is the unsatisfactory use of eco-friendly and biodegradable chemicals during their manufacturing stages.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Circular economy initiatives|Circular approaches in manufacturing_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the integrated fuzzy MCDM approach for manufacturing process improvement in MSMEs proposed by Xu et al. (2023)?
nodes.answer: The integrated fuzzy MCDM approach proposed by Xu et al. (2023) aims to provide a method for decision-making in manufacturing process improvement for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Circular economy initiatives|Circular approaches in manufacturing_qna_003
nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: How can digital technologies be integrated into the existing structure to enhance material efficiency in denim production?
nodes.answer: Digital technologies can be used to optimize production processes, track material usage in real-time, and identify areas for improvement to enhance material efficiency.
